name: Roland RD-300GX
description: Roland RD-300GX digital stage piano (2008): the system blocks and the temporary SETUP — common, rhythm/arpeggio, chorus, reverb, the Internal and External Zone of each of its three keyboard zones, and the sixteen Parts with each Part's piano settings — from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-300GX MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Feb. 1, 2008)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-300GX_MI.pdf (sha256 a4c897502ccf80b07f433090e8377129ab8686e033caf3b270fddd0a14d149fa). Model ID 00 00 2C, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Presets list the SETUPs (Bank Select MSB 85, LSB 0, p1), which are recalled on the SETUP Control Channel (System Common 00 05), which must match the profile's channel. The table's other rows (GM/GM2 tones and rhythm sets, Rhythm Set 86/64, the tone categories 87/64 and up) select a Part's sound, which the Part block sets by bank and program number.

Not laid out: the SETUP MFX table (p9). The SETUP offset table (p7) lists Common 00 00 00, Rhythm/AudioKey 00 02 00, Chorus 00 04 00, Reverb 00 06 00, the zones 00 30 00 - 00 42 00, the Parts 00 50 00 - 00 5F 00 and their Piano blocks 01 00 00 - 01 0F 00, and no MFX. Its table is the RD-700GX's, row for row (MFX Type 0 - 255), where the RD-700GX places eight at 00 10 00 - 00 1E 00; nothing on the RD-300GX's pages says it lives there too.

p11 <Example1> prints Reverb Level's address as 10 00 08 01 in its prose and its last line, and 10 00 06 01 in its byte diagram and its sum; the checksum it works out (05) is 06's. The address map gives 10 00 06 01, and the checked example is F0 41 10 00 00 2C 12 10 00 06 01 64 05 F7.

SETUP Common (p8) prints no rows at 00 37 - 00 4E (between Upper [RHY/GM2] Tone Category and Lower [Piano] Tone Category), 00 72 and 00 76, and its rows end at 00 78 against a Total Size of 00 00 00 7A; the block is requested whole. SETUP External Zone (p9) prints no row at 00 11.
Setup Piano Setting's Hammer Noise Level (00 04, 62 - 66) prints its display as "-2 - 2OFF, 1 - 10" (p10), two lines run together; it stays a number 62 - 66 with the manual's line as its description.
Arpeggio Motif (SETUP Rhythm/Arpeggio/AudioKey 00 0B) prints a full stop for a comma ("UP(H&L).UP(_)") and "RHASE" (p9), so its list counts eleven labels for twelve values; it stays a number 0 - 11.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.piano, part2.piano, part3.piano, part4.piano, part5.piano, part6.piano, part7.piano, part8.piano, part9.piano, part10.piano, part11.piano, part12.piano, part13.piano, part14.piano, part15.piano, part16.piano.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the sliders, pedals and S1/S2 transmit as CC (Data Transmission, p6) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: chorus, reverb and MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.mfx: not laid out: the map prints a SETUP MFX table (p9: MFX Type at 00 02, MFX Parameter 1-32 at 00 10 - 01 0C, Total Size 00 00 01 10), but neither the SETUP offset table (p7) nor any other gives it an address. Each Part's MFX1 Switch and MFX1 Type (SETUP Part 00 15-00 16) and SETUP Common's MFX Source (00 75) are laid out
coverage.memories: none in the map: the SETUP memories (001-032, p1) have no addresses in the MIDI Implementation
